'''''SBT 1''''' was a [[Heavy Lifter/Legends|Heavy Lifter]] used by forces loyal to rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]]. The Lifter was present at a [[Supply Base]] located in the [[Gwar system/Legends|Gwar system]]. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces lead by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kuuztin]] launched an [[Battle of Gwar|attack]] on the base and destroyed the base, but fell into a trap. It is likely that the Lifter was destroyed in the battle.
